title: How metabox works
intro: Follow one connection from a device in your network. Select a step to see what it means and where to configure it.
stopped: The core is stopped. There are no connections to show.
failed: The core crashed. There are no connections to show.
unconfirmed: The matching rule could not be linked to the applied config.

terms.heading: Terms
terms.groupExample: When a rule points straight to a server, the outbound and server are the same.

device.title: Device
device.description: A computer, phone or TV on your network. A rule can apply to just one device.

service.title: Service
service.description: A ready-made list of sites or addresses that a rule refers to by name. The Editor calls it a rule set.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: A condition and an action for a connection. The core checks rules from top to bottom and uses the first match.

outbound.title: Outbound
outbound.description: Where a rule sends traffic. It can be a group, a server or a direct connection.

group.title: Group
group.description: Servers or other groups under one name. A group can pick by latency or use your manual choice.

server.title: Server
server.description: A proxy server with an address, a protocol and a key.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.description: A VPN provider's link that supplies a list of servers and keeps it up to date.

core.title: Core
core.description: The program on the router that applies rules to connections. Overview shows its status and Settings holds its controls.
